A '''skirmish''' took place in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[ST 321/Legends|''ST 321'']]. While aboard the shuttle headed back from [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] were attacked by traitorous [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Sheyvan]] and six [[Cuis clone|clones]] of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sa Cuis]]. They took control of the ship and Vader, along with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Erv Lekauf]] and his clones, were forced to engage the Dark Jedi in combat.

[[File:Sheyvan.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Sheyvan engages Darth Vader.]]

Armed with [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]], the Lekauf clones burned four Cuis clones; the remaining two were Force choked by Vader. Sheyvan fought Vader alone in a brief duel and attempted to turn Vader against Palpatine, but was ultimately killed. Afterward, the Sa Cuis template was decommissioned, although the Emperor remained open to the possibility of [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] army in the future.

Lekauf, however, was burned during the battle. Vader tended to Lekauf, which was a contributing factor to Lekauf's immense respect for the Dark Lord, which he later transmitted to his grandson, [[Jori Lekauf]]. Jori would later reference the injuries his grandfather suffered during the battle.
